lines.text: Jesus goes to a town called Nain, and His disciples and a large crowd go with Him.
Near the town gate, Jesus sees a dead man being carried out, the only son of a widow.
Jesus has compassion on the widow, touches the coffin, and tells the young man to get up.
The dead man sits up and begins to speak, and Jesus gives him back to his brothers.
The people call Jesus a great king, and the news about Him spreads throughout Judea.
